claims.text: The two new unsupervised representation-learning objectives introduced are Sequential Denoising Autoencoders (SDAEs) and FastSent.
SDAEs are designed to recover original data from corrupted versions, making them suitable for variable-length sentences.
FastSent is a sentence-level log-linear bag-of-words model that performs well on unsupervised benchmarks like the SICK sentence relatedness task.
